title: Signed integer overflow in `XML_GetBuffer` (`neededSize += keep`) skips reallocation and causes heap buffer overflow
Integer overflow in `storeRawNames` (`bufSize`) skips `REALLOC` and causes heap buffer overflow (plus signed shift overflow in `doContent`)
Unchecked `unsigned` overflow in `dtd->contentStringLen` causes undersized allocation in `build_model` and heap buffer overflow in `build_node`
Heap buffer overflow on `dtd->scaffIndex` via capacity desynchronization and shrinking between root and external PE parsers
Use-after-free and double-free of parent parser's shared `m_dtd` on OOM in `parserCreate` via `XML_ExternalEntityParserCreate`
UTF-8 validation bypass in XML names accepts overlong sequences, non-continuation bytes, embedded NULs, and delimiter-swallowing bytes
Heap use-after-free in `internalEntityProcessor` due to missing `storeRawNames(parser)` (plus wrong `m_processor` for external general entities)
`allowClosingDoctype` guard bypassed in `internalEntityProcessor`, allowing DOCTYPE closure and encoding/processor confusion from resumed internal PE
Unbounded C-stack recursion (stack overflow crash) in `build_node` and non-cyclic entity expansion chains
Namespace separator injection in `addBinding` and expanded attribute name collisions / incomplete duplicate check in `storeAtts`
Missing `len` bounds validation (`len < 0` / OOB) and unchecked signed `m_parseEndByteIndex` overflow in `XML_ParseBuffer`
Unsynchronized shared parent-parser access in `XML_ExternalEntityParserCreate` child parsers causes data races and UAF, violating documented thread-safety contract
Complete bypass of amplification protection under `XML_UseForeignDTD` when document begins directly with root element
Undefined behavior (`NULL - s`) and accounting counter corruption in `epilogProcessor` on negative prolog tokens
Unchecked `parser->m_groupSize * sizeof(int)` overflow on 32-bit platforms in `nextScaffoldPart` initial `dtd->scaffIndex` allocation
NULL function pointer dereference in `XML_MIN_SIZE` builds when a UTF-16 high surrogate appears in any XML name
`DEFINE_UTF16_TO_UTF16` (`little2_toUtf16`/`big2_toUtf16`) wrong bitmask and boundary check drops low surrogates and splits surrogate pairs
Missing UTF-16 surrogate pair validation (`IS_INVALID_CHAR` always `0`) accepts unpaired high surrogates paired with arbitrary code units
Out-of-bounds read and unbounded loop past `fromLim` in `unknown_toUtf8` / `unknown_toUtf16`, reachable via `parsePseudoAttribute` step desync
Out-of-bounds pointer advance (`ptr += n` past `end`) in `attributeValueTok`, `entityValueTok`, and `updatePosition`
`externalSubset1` rejects all valid internal PE references inside `<![INCLUDE[ ... ]]>` and allows a PE to close an outer `INCLUDE` section
`ignoreSectionTok` fails to recognize `]]>` after odd runs of `]` (e.g., `]]]>`) and omits `ptr >= end` guard
`internalEntityProcessor` abandons outer nested internal entities on resume and continues parsing after suspend on final entity token
`XML_ROLE_ENTITY_VALUE` commits entity value and invokes `m_entityDeclHandler` (potentially with `value == NULL`) before checking `storeEntityValue` error
`setContext` leaves `prefix->name == NULL` in `dtd->prefixes` on OOM; retrying `XML_Parse` causes NULL dereference in `keyeq`
Unchecked `lookup()` failure in `getAttributeId` for `xmlns:*` silently drops namespace binding and leaks raw attribute
NULL function pointer dereferences if `m_startDoctypeDeclHandler` (`XML_ROLE_DOCTYPE_CLOSE`) or `m_defaultHandler` (`reportDefault`) is cleared dynamically
Use-after-free in `XML_Parse` (`#ifndef XML_CONTEXT_BYTES`) when querying line/column after error or final chunk
Uninitialized heap reads in `XML_GetIdAttributeIndex` (`m_idAttIndex`), `XML_GetParsingStatus` (`finalBuffer`), and `poolGrow` (`freeBlocks` copy)
Unrelated pointer subtraction UB and heap-distance leak in `storeAtts` (`XML_ATTR_INFO`) during internal entity expansion
Multiple processor state bugs in `cdataSectionProcessor`, `externalEntityInitProcessor3`, `entityValueInitProcessor`, `XML_ParserReset`, and `XML_StopParser`
Dead `!dtd->hasParamEntityRefs` WFC check, self-referential PE `NULL + 0` UB, and uncleared `m_tempPool` on skipped ATTLIST enum
Wrong `EXPAT_FMT_*` format specifiers on MinGW-w64 / 32-bit platforms, and `#ifdef XML_DTD` guard hiding `XML_SetBillionLaughsAttackProtection*` declarations
Memory leak of `BINDING` struct on integer-overflow error paths in `addBinding`
Double-counting of direct bytes for non-empty start-tag attributes (`XML_TOK_START_TAG_WITH_ATTS`) weakens amplification limit
`prologTok` shrinks odd UTF-16 `end` locally causing `doProlog` to swallow stray trailing bytes; `DEFINE_UTF16_TO_UTF8` returns `COMPLETED` on odd input
`prologTok` `BT_COLON` accepts `NameChar` instead of `NameStartChar` after `:`, and `BT_RPAR` rejects `)` followed by `%`
Character-table and declaration edge-case defects (`latin1tab.h`, `doParseXmlDecl`, `isPublicId`, `_INTERNAL_trim_to_complete_utf8_characters`)
Short-read / stale-`errno` loop bug in `writeRandomBytes_*`, `XML_GetBuffer(p, 0)` API inconsistency, and signed `int` length in `copyString`
Signed `attIndex` / `nPrefixes << 1` / `int j` overflows in `storeAtts` at `>= 2^29` attributes; unchecked `state->includeLevel += 1` wrap in `condSect1`
`XML_XmlDeclHandler` `version == NULL` contract mismatch for TextDecls, `XML_GetUserData(NULL)` dereference, and `#define inline` issues in `internal.h`
